_comment: Row 323. Re-run from a detached standalone scratch tree: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row323_census_expiry_refusal.json --work SCRATCH. The collection catchers assert the band-body sentinel was never written; the integration catcher asserts the first generator's sentinel was never written. The separate transform-control spec applies M1's identical valid transform under a no-pin row and must ESCAPE.
